story.jaymoskingdoms.road.written.tale: Now you wake under a roof that isn't yours, in a place someone made ready for whoever the night would bring in.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.written.short: Woken in a place made ready.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.written.wake: You wake in a shelter out in the wild, laid in for a traveller. What's there was left for whoever came, and the way on is written there too.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.written.hint: Nobody has made a place ready yet.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.written.0: You came in out of the wild? Somebody was looking after you, then.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.written.1: You slept in one of the keeper's huts. You have the smell of the hearth on you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.written.2: Walked in from the wild with nothing much and all your fingers. That's a good start.
